description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Double Sphere Mode (Fire, Dark)], [Awoken Legend], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Perfection Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Legend
description.text: Dark and Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Double Sphere Mode (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Dark] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Perfection Mode
description.text: Grants [Fire Perfection Mode]/[Dark Perfection Mode] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Fire Perfection Mode
description.text: Critical chance =50/75/100% after using 1/2/3+ Fire abilities, casts Execution Shot (Fire) after using a Fire ability, removed if the character hasn't [Perfection Mode]

description.name: Execution Shot (Fire)
description.text: Five single ranged attacks (0.39 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Dark Perfection Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00/2.50/3.00 after using 1/2/3+ Dark abilities, casts Execution Shot (Dark) after using a Dark ability, removed if the character hasn't [Perfection Mode]

description.name: Execution Shot (Dark)
description.text: Five single ranged attacks (0.39 each), 100% hit rate
